<!--
  VCHRGD / Frasers Plus product-listing banner, max 360 x 470.
  Read more opens the official Frasers Plus website in a new tab.
-->
<style>
  .vchrgd-fp-product,
  .vchrgd-fp-product * { box-sizing: border-box; }

  .vchrgd-fp-product {
    --fp-accent: #b115f4;
    isolation: isolate;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 360px;
    min-height: 470px;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 9px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px 16px 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 23%, rgba(62,31,112,.72), transparent 38%),
      linear-gradient(160deg, #251450 0%, #080216 78%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Century Gothic", sans-serif;
  }

  .vchrgd-fp-product::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    z-index: -1;
    top: 24px;
    left: 50%;
    width: 210px;
    height: 210px;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(177,21,244,.14), transparent 66%);
    filter: blur(3px);
  }

  .vchrgd-fp-product__icon { width: 140px; height: 140px; object-fit: contain; }
  .vchrgd-fp-product__wordmark { width: 235px; max-width: 90%; height: auto; margin-top: -2px; }
  .vchrgd-fp-product h2,
  .vchrgd-fp-product p { margin: 0; color: inherit; }
  .vchrgd-fp-product h2 { max-width: 300px; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.15; }
  .vchrgd-fp-product__apr { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.12; }
  .vchrgd-fp-product__legal { max-width: 318px; color: #eee9f7 !important; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.2; }

  .vchrgd-fp-product__cta {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 48px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-top: 4px;
    padding: 11px 18px;
    color: #fff !important;
    background: var(--fp-accent);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
    border-radius: 7px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 750;
    line-height: 1;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    transition: transform 160ms ease, filter 160ms ease;
  }

  .vchrgd-fp-product__cta:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .vchrgd-fp-product__cta:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #43e9ed; outline-offset: 3px; }

  @media (max-width: 340px) {
    .vchrgd-fp-product { min-height: 0; }
    .vchrgd-fp-product__icon { width: 120px; height: 120px; }
  }
</style>

<section class="vchrgd-fp-product" aria-labelledby="vchrgd-fp-product-title">
  <img class="vchrgd-fp-product__icon" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">
  <img class="vchrgd-fp-product__wordmark" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Frasers Plus">
  <h2 id="vchrgd-fp-product-title">Buy now. Pay later.<br>Earn rewards</h2>
  <p class="vchrgd-fp-product__apr">Representative 29.9% APR variable</p>
  <p class="vchrgd-fp-product__legal">Credit subject to status. Missed payments may affect your credit score. Terms apply.</p>
  <a class="vchrgd-fp-product__cta" href="https://frasersplus.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Read more</a>
</section>
